# fluss-go v0.1.0-beta.10

This prerelease aligns the experimental Go client and administration APIs with
the public terminology and configuration concepts of Apache Fluss 0.9.1.

## Highlights

- Renames the hand-written `fgo` data API around Fluss bootstrap servers,
  append and upsert writers, lookupers, server nodes and types, no-key
  assigners, fetch limits, and request or batch timeouts.
- Renames the hand-written `fadm` administration API around Fluss descriptors,
  info and summary objects, ACL bindings, KV snapshots, and explicit `Get*`,
  `List*`, and rebalance operations.
- Adds a complete mapping of all 39 Fluss 0.9.1 client configuration keys,
  distinguishing direct Go mappings, intentional Go-specific controls, and
  settings that are Java-specific or not implemented.
- Keeps generated `pkg/fmsg` request, response, registry, and protobuf names
  unchanged because they follow the pinned Fluss wire contract.
- Records naming and configuration review rules so future public API work is
  checked against the complete affected Fluss surface before a PR is opened.

## Upgrade notes

- This release intentionally breaks the experimental pre-v1 `fgo` and `fadm`
  source API. Deprecated aliases are not provided. Review the
  [complete beta.9 migration table][api-migration] before
  upgrading.
- Configuration users should review the
  [Fluss 0.9.1 client configuration mapping][client-configuration],
  especially the documented differences for TLS termination, metrics,
  request boundaries, memory controls, and Java-only settings.
- No Fluss wire protocol input, data-path semantics, or external dependency is
  changed. The former combined lake-snapshot selector is split into the three
  operations exposed by the Fluss Admin API. Generated `pkg/fmsg` applications
  are unaffected unless they also use `fgo` or `fadm`.
- All four optional adapter modules are published at beta.10 and require the
  beta.10 root module.
- The compatibility target remains Apache Fluss `0.9.1-incubating` at commit
  `6bf969f71af8d6f9cc37383ab89ae46a58b0e227`.
- Use Go 1.25.12 or newer in the 1.25 series, or Go 1.26.5 or newer in the 1.26
  series.

## Upgrade documentation

- Start with the [beta.9 API migration table][api-migration] and the
  [complete changelog][changelog].
- Connection and configuration: [client configuration mapping][client-configuration]
  and [TLS and SASL authentication][authentication].
- Data API: [data operations][data-operations], [typed API][typed-api],
  [write scheduling][write-scheduling], [lookup scheduling][lookup-scheduling],
  [schema evolution][schema-evolution], and [error handling][error-handling].
- Administration and runtime behavior: [administration operations][admin-operations],
  [architecture and ownership][architecture], [observability][observability],
  [remote storage and filesystem tokens][remote-storage], and
  [live compatibility evidence][live-evidence].
- Optional module manuals: [HDFS][hdfs-adapter], [Alibaba Cloud OSS][oss-adapter],
  [OpenTelemetry][otel-adapter], and [AWS SDK v2 S3][s3-adapter].
- The [README documentation index][readme] links the remaining design,
  reliability, security, and contribution references.

This is a pre-v1 release. Pin the root and adapter module versions and review
the changelog before upgrading.
